units.function: names the field as a hot spot and the old plan as failing

features.quantitative_role: dates the proposal to a decade
original_instantiations: planning called a hot spot of most concern
the older sprawl plan gradually unable to meet demand

units.source_excerpt: With the development of global urbanization, urban planning has been a hot spot of most concern.
units.reusable_pattern: Open a summary by calling the field a hot spot of most concern, then say the older plan has been gradually unable to meet the need.
reusable_elements: a hot spot of most concern
prohibited_generalizations: do not smooth this into a rising-concern opener

units.function: lists the methods in the order the tasks use them

original_instantiations: one indicator on top, five under it, twenty five at the bottom
entropy weights the bottom level, group decision the middle

units.source_excerpt: 25 indicators are selected by principal component analysis. Then we construct a new three-level indicator system.
units.reusable_pattern: Stack the methods in task order and give the count at each level of the system.
prohibited_generalizations: do not collapse the three counts into one

units.function: reports which initiative has the most potential in each city

original_instantiations: ningguo gains most from pushing economic development
pittsburgh gains most from a higher land intensive rate

units.source_excerpt: The result shows that the most potential to the success degree of the smart growth is the initiative of the economic development in Ningguo, while in Pittsburgh is the initiative of improving land intensive rate.
units.reusable_pattern: State the result as the most potential, then name one initiative per city with while.
prohibited_generalizations: do not rank the initiatives in a table here

units.function: claims the plan adjusts to the population on its own

features.quantitative_role: ties the claim to the computed growth rate
original_instantiations: the computed growth rate is what demonstrates the claim
the plan adjusts on its own to the rising population

units.source_excerpt: The growth rate calculated by PGM demonstrates that our plan can adjust adaptively to satisfied the increasing need of population.
units.reusable_pattern: Close by letting the computed rate demonstrate the claim, and keep the verb as the paper wrote it.
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct the verb into grammatical English

units.function: treats urbanization as already settled

features.quantitative_role: gives the share and the year
original_instantiations: urbanization treated as an inevitable trend
two thirds of people added to cities by mid century

units.source_excerpt: In recent years, urbanization has become an inevitable trend.
units.reusable_pattern: Call the trend inevitable before giving the forecast number.
prohibited_generalizations: do not argue whether the trend could be otherwise

units.function: explains a strategy by a household image

original_instantiations: sprawl glossed as a standing pancake
expansion onto land never developed before

units.source_excerpt: At an earlier time, some cities chose urban sprawl strategy, namely, just like standing pancake.
units.reusable_pattern: Gloss a planning term with namely and a plain image rather than a definition.
prohibited_generalizations: do not replace the image with a formal definition

units.function: lets the problems surface one after another

original_instantiations: problems said to have been exposed one by one
pollution, excess land use, costly infrastructure

units.source_excerpt: Gradually, many problems were exposed when urban sprawl was carried out.
units.reusable_pattern: Say the problems were exposed rather than listing them as consequences.
prohibited_generalizations: do not write this as a neat consequence list

units.function: walks the tasks as a chain of needs

original_instantiations: the index needed first, then needed again later
ranking comes next and the population last

units.source_excerpt: Therefore, index system is needed to evaluate the success of smart growth of a city firstly.
units.reusable_pattern: Chain the tasks with firstly, then, moreover and eventually, repeating that the index is needed a second time.
prohibited_generalizations: do not number the tasks in the prose

units.function: points at the flow chart with a stock phrase

original_instantiations: the flow chart shown after the analysis, as fellows
a figure carries the whole task order

units.source_excerpt: Through the above analysis, the flow chart of this paper is shown in fig.1 as fellows.
units.reusable_pattern: Hand off to a figure with through the above analysis and as fellows.
prohibited_generalizations: do not correct fellows to follows

units.function: freezes policy for the short term

original_instantiations: policy frozen for the short term

units.source_excerpt: The government policy will not change in the short term.
units.reusable_pattern: State an assumption as a flat bullet with no hedge.

units.function: drops sudden change from the forecast

units.function: says no measure survives bad data

units.function: offers four ways to fill a gap

units.function: says the chosen method solves the problem

original_instantiations: entropy weight with a correlation coefficient adopted

units.function: proposes one index for the success degree

units.function: tells the reader what the diagram shows
